answer: A farm faking 481 aliases needs 481 separate roof records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Thatcher guild membership with roof completion records is the check: roofs thatched under one guild ticket for years. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The plume record shows the asymmetry: scale multiplies the cost but never the reward, the ocean entry is checkable by anyone, and the spiral window closes before a farm can catch up.
